title: Horizon Implementation Day: Finding opportunities and submitting a proposal in Horizon Europe
organiser: European Commission, DG Research and Innovation
summary: A morning of Commission briefings for first-time applicants: how Horizon Europe is organised, how to find calls and partners, and how proposals are written and evaluated.
covers: A general overview of Horizon Europe
Searching for calls and partners in the Funding & Tenders Portal
The proposal template, basic submission principles and the evaluation criteria
materials: Agenda and presentation slides for each session
why: It is the most complete official starting point for a team preparing its first Horizon Europe proposal. Watching the evaluation part before drafting helps write each section against the criteria experts actually score.
source_name: European Commission · Research and innovation community platform (related webinars)
